description: Oracle fixture of the evaluation scorecard v2. The expected values were computed by an independent Python enumeration that shares no code with the TypeScript metric modules. The manifest carries no manifestHash: the test attaches the shipped computeManifestHash before building the scorecard.

notes.reason: item-level partition: the capture-group property is NOT enforced, so the items of one capture group may sit in different splits. The partition is stratified by class and anomaly instead; 4 capture group(s) were too large to be kept whole.

groupBasis.statement: This partition is ITEM-LEVEL: the capture-group property is NOT enforced, so the items of one capture group may sit in different splits. It is stratified by class and anomaly instead, and it cannot prove acquisition-level independence.
